title: User Login with Correct Credentials
description: Verify that users with valid credentials can log in successfully and receive appropriate role-based access.

steps.description: Navigate to login page
Enter valid username/email and password
Submit login form
Verify that login succeeds and user is redirected to dashboard based on role

title: User Login with Incorrect Credentials
description: Verify that login attempt with invalid credentials fails and appropriate error message is displayed.

steps.description: Navigate to login page
Enter invalid username/email or password
Submit login form
Verify that login fails and error message is displayed

title: Two-Factor Authentication Setup and Verification
description: Ensure that two-factor authentication (2FA) can be set up and is required during login for users with 2FA enabled.

steps.description: Log in as a user without 2FA enabled
Navigate to 2FA setup page
Complete 2FA setup process
Verify 2FA setup is successful
Log out and attempt to log in again
Enter username and password
Provide 2FA token when prompted
Verify login completes successfully only with correct 2FA token

title: Session Timeout and Logout
description: Verify that user sessions timeout after inactivity and that users are logged out securely.

steps.description: Log in with valid credentials
Remain idle for session timeout duration
Verify user is automatically logged out after timeout
Attempt to access protected pages after logout
Verify access is denied and user is redirected to login

title: Patient Registration with Unique CPF and Secure Document Upload
description: Verify that new patient registration validates unique CPF and allows secure photo and document upload.

steps.description: Navigate to patient registration form
Enter valid patient details including unique CPF
Upload photo and required documents
Submit registration
Verify patient is registered successfully and documents are stored securely
Attempt to register another patient with same CPF
Verify system prevents duplicate CPF registration and shows error

title: Appointment Scheduling with Conflict Prevention
description: Verify that appointment scheduling prevents conflicts and supports daily, weekly, and monthly views with recurring events.

steps.description: Navigate to scheduling page
Create an appointment for a specific time slot
Verify appointment is created and appears in all calendar views
Attempt to create a conflicting appointment for the same clinician and time
Verify conflict prevention prevents booking and shows error
Schedule recurring weekly appointments
Verify recurring appointments appear correctly in calendar views

title: Appointment Notification Delivery
description: Verify that notifications are sent reliably for scheduled, rescheduled, and cancelled appointments.

steps.description: Schedule a new appointment
Verify notification is sent to patient and clinician
Reschedule the appointment
Verify updated notification is sent
Cancel the appointment
Verify cancellation notification is sent

title: Clinical Documentation Auto-Save and Version History
description: Verify auto-save functionality during clinical note editing and that version history is maintained and accessible.

steps.description: Open clinical documentation editor
Enter text into editor
Verify auto-save triggers periodically without data loss
Make multiple edits over time
Access version history
Verify previous versions are accessible and accurately recorded

title: AI Assistant Report Generation Accuracy
description: Verify AI Assistant generates clinical reports with an accuracy rate exceeding 95% based on input data.

steps.description: Provide clinical session data to AI Assistant
Request automatic report generation
Verify generated report matches expected clinical content with over 95% accuracy

title: AI Treatment Protocol Suggestion Validity
description: Verify AI Assistant suggests appropriate treatment protocols based on patient data and clinical input.

steps.description: Input patient clinical data into AI Assistance system
Request treatment protocol suggestions
Verify suggested protocols are clinically valid and personalized

title: Exercise Library Contraindication Alerts
description: Verify exercise prescriptions trigger alerts for contraindications according to patient data.

steps.description: Select exercise for patient with contraindicating conditions
Verify alert is shown indicating contraindications
Attempt to prescribe said exercise
Verify system prevents or warns about inappropriate prescription

title: Patient Portal Secure Access and Data Privacy
description: Verify patients can securely access their personal records, exercise prescriptions, appointments, and communicate with clinic adhering to data privacy.

steps.description: Log in as patient to patient portal
Verify access to personal records and exercise plans
Navigate to appointment scheduling and communication pages
Verify functionality is accessible and data privacy controls are enforced

title: Reports Export Format and Accuracy
description: Verify reports export correctly in PDF format with accurate clinical and financial data and proper formatting.

steps.description: Generate clinical and financial reports from dashboard
Export reports as PDF
Verify exported PDFs contain accurate and visually accurate data and charts

title: Financial Payment Processing and Delinquency Tracking
description: Verify payments can be processed through multiple methods including PIX with accurate financial metrics and delinquency tracking.

steps.description: Process a payment via PIX integration
Verify payment is recorded and reflected in financial dashboard
Simulate overdue payment scenario
Verify delinquency tracking flags the overdue status correctly

title: System Uptime and Concurrent User Handling
description: Verify system maintains at least 99.5% availability and handles 100 concurrent users without degradation.

steps.description: Simulate 100 concurrent user sessions performing diverse operations
Verify system remains responsive and uptime metrics exceed 99.5%

title: Automated Backup and Audit Log Integrity
description: Verify backups run automatically daily and audit logs capture all critical system actions securely and comprehensively.

steps.description: Trigger or wait for automated backup process
Verify backup file is created, complete, and restorable
Perform various system actions with auditing enabled
Verify audit logs accurately record actions with timestamps and user details

title: Responsive Design and Performance Optimization Test
description: Verify system is responsive across all device types and maintains load time under 2 seconds including lazy loading and PWA features.

steps.description: Access system from desktop, tablet, and smartphone devices
Verify UI elements adjust properly and user experience is consistent
Measure page load times under various network conditions
Verify load times are under 2 seconds and lazy loading defers non-critical content

title: Interactive Body Map Pain Point Marking and Evolution Tracking
description: Verify healthcare staff can mark pain points on interactive body map and track pain evolution over time.

steps.description: Access interactive body map for a patient
Mark multiple pain points with severity scales
Verify pain points are correctly saved and displayed
Add follow-up pain point entries during subsequent visits
Verify evolution charts reflect changes accurately over time

title: Teleconsultation Video Call Functionality and Stability
description: Verify teleconsultation video calls connect properly, maintain audio/video quality, and handle network interruptions gracefully.

steps.description: Initiate teleconsultation video call between clinician and patient
Verify video and audio streams establish successfully with minimal latency
Simulate network interruption during call
Verify call handles disconnection gracefully and attempts reconnection

title: Role-Based Access Control Enforcement Across Modules
description: Verify users have permissions strictly corresponding to their roles preventing unauthorized access to system features and data.

steps.description: Log in as Administrator
Verify full access to system settings, user management, financial data, and inventory
Log in as Physiotherapist
Verify access to patient records, clinical documentation, scheduling, and exercise prescription; no access to admin financial or inventory modules
Log in as Patient
Verify access only to patient portal features like records, exercises, appointments, and communication
